name: Admin PATCH Student Account & Academic Info
curlCommand:
curl -X PATCH "http://localhost:3000/dashboard/admin/students/2" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOjEsInJvbGUiOiJhZG1pbiIsImZhbWlseSI6ImQ4OTZkNGQ1LTVmMjUtNGFlYS1iNzUxLTE3MzU0ZWMxMTQxNSIsInR5cGUiOiJhY2Nlc3MiLCJpYXQiOjE3ODY2OTM1MzIsImV4cCI6MTc4NjY5NDQzMn0.Frv4A7SRzZlCdifFuJwYIvIxjjDErYxX-rxM1nrZQiQ" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Length: 123" \
  -d '{"contactNumber":"09171234567","strandProgram":"BS Computer Science - Software Engineering","addressDistrict":"District 2"}'
dbVerificationQuery:
SELECT s.contact_number, s.address_district, sai.strand_program
        FROM public.student s
        JOIN public.student_academic_information sai ON sai.student_id = s.student_id
        WHERE s.user_account_id = 2
notes: Updates student contact number, program, and district; strictly whitelisted.

name: Admin PATCH PESO Personnel & Verification Status
curlCommand:
curl -X PATCH "http://localhost:3000/dashboard/admin/peso-personnel/8" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOjEsInJvbGUiOiJhZG1pbiIsImZhbWlseSI6ImQ4OTZkNGQ1LTVmMjUtNGFlYS1iNzUxLTE3MzU0ZWMxMTQxNSIsInR5cGUiOiJhY2Nlc3MiLCJpYXQiOjE3ODY2OTM1MzIsImV4cCI6MTc4NjY5NDQzMn0.Frv4A7SRzZlCdifFuJwYIvIxjjDErYxX-rxM1nrZQiQ" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Length: 176" \
  -d '{"department":"QC PESO Employment & Quality Assurance Division","verificationStatus":"approved","verificationRemark":"Approved by Senior QA automated verification test suite."}'
dbVerificationQuery:
SELECT department, verification_status, verification_remark, reviewed_by_user_account_id
        FROM public.peso_personnel
        WHERE user_account_id = 8

dbVerificationResult.department: QC PESO Employment & Quality Assurance Division
dbVerificationResult.verification_remark: Approved by Senior QA automated verification test suite.

notes: Updates PESO department and verifies account with reviewer tracking.
